verse.verse_1: When the sun (with its spacious light) is folded up;
verse.verse_2: When the stars fall, losing their lustre;
verse.verse_3: When the mountains vanish (like a mirage);
verse.verse_4: When the she-camels, ten months with young, are left untended;
verse.verse_5: When the wild beasts are herded together (in the human habitations);
verse.verse_6: When the oceans boil over with a swell;
verse.verse_7: When the souls are sorted out, (being joined, like with like);
verse.verse_8: When the female (infant), buried alive, is questioned -
verse.verse_9: For what crime she was killed;
verse.verse_10: When the scrolls are laid open;
verse.verse_11: When the world on High is unveiled;
verse.verse_12: When the Blazing Fire is kindled to fierce heat;
verse.verse_13: And when the Garden is brought near;-
verse.verse_14: (Then) shall each soul know what it has put forward.
verse.verse_15: So verily I call to witness the planets - that recede,
verse.verse_17: And the Night as it dissipates;
verse.verse_18: And the Dawn as it breathes away the darkness;-
verse.verse_19: Verily this is the word of a most honourable Messenger,
verse.verse_20: Endued with Power, with rank before the Lord of the Throne,
verse.verse_21: With authority there, (and) faithful to his trust.
verse.verse_22: And (O people!) your companion is not one possessed;
verse.verse_23: And without doubt he saw him in the clear horizon.
verse.verse_24: Neither doth he withhold grudgingly a knowledge of the Unseen.
verse.verse_25: Nor is it the word of an evil spirit accursed.
verse.verse_27: Verily this is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds:
verse.verse_28: (With profit) to whoever among you wills to go straight:
verse.verse_29: But ye shall not will except as Allah wills,- the Cherisher of the Worlds.
